script: In December 1944, Hitler picked his most dangerous commando to run an insane operation. Otto Skorzeny recruited German soldiers who spoke fluent English, dressed them in captured American uniforms, and sent them driving American jeeps straight through US Army checkpoints. Their job was to spread confusion, switch road signs, and cut communication wires behind enemy lines during the Battle of the Bulge. It worked so well that American soldiers stopped trusting each other completely. Checkpoints started asking baseball scores and state capitals just to catch the fakes, and even top American generals got detained and questioned by their own men. The operation caused far more panic than actual damage. Hitler had turned simple disguises into one of the biggest psychological weapons of the entire war.
